code: block_result_output.my_table <- function(result, block, session, ...) {   session$output$csv <- shiny::downloadHandler(     filename = "table.csv",     content = function(file) {       # the title as it reads now, without the script's `ui_*` lines       title <- blockr.script::result_titles(session, ui = FALSE)$title       writeLines(c(title, ""), file)       utils::write.table(         result$data, file, append = TRUE, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE       )     }   )    blockr.script::result_head(     session,     # a link or button with an icon becomes an icon button     tools = shiny::downloadLink(       session$ns("csv"), label = shiny::icon("download"), title = "Download"     ),     # shown where the script has no `#| title:` line     titles = list(title = "My table"),     # this method draws the caption under the table     caption = FALSE   )    shiny::renderUI(shiny::tagList(     draw_my_table(result),     shiny::tags$p(blockr.script::result_titles(session)$caption)   )) } block_result_output.my_table <- function(result, block, session, ...) {   shiny::renderUI(my_table_widget(result$data, id = session$ns("table"))) }  block_result_update.my_table <- function(result, block, session, ...) {   update_my_table_widget(session, session$ns("table"), result$data)   TRUE } new_my_table_block <- function(script = "my_table(data)", values = list(),                                ...) {   blockr.script::new_script_block(     script, values,     starters = list(       list(label = "By group", hint = "one row per group",            script = "my_table(data, by = \"group\")")     ),     class = "my_table_block",     ...   ) }
